name: ESP32-P4-Function-EV-Board (P4X)
description: Multimedia board for the ESP32-P4: 16 MB flash, 32 MB PSRAM, MIPI-DSI 7-inch touch LCD, MIPI-CSI camera, 10/100 Ethernet, USB 2.0 HS host and Wi-Fi 6/BLE through a C6 co-processor.
notes: The ESP32-P4 has no radio: Wi-Fi 6 and BLE come from an on-board ESP32-C6-MINI-1 module connected over SDIO (ESP-Hosted), flashed separately.
The original board (P4 chip rev < 3) is obsolete; current stock is the ESP32-P4X-Function-EV-Board (chip rev 3.x). Match ESP-IDF/doc version to your chip revision.
Reference price is for the kit with the 7-inch 1024x600 touch LCD and 2 MP camera; the bare mainboard is not sold separately in most shops.
Ethernet is 10/100 (RMII, IP101 PHY). Three USB-C ports (UART/JTAG, full-speed, HS OTG) plus a USB 2.0 Type-A host port (shares the HS controller with the Type-C OTG port).
Size is the PCB outline taken from the Espressif DXF (approx.); 23 GPIOs on the 2x20 J1 header, many others used by on-board peripherals.
